note: An all-time high is the highest price a market has printed. On this hook it is also the other high: the line before is "hit that bong." The 2022 Pizza Day single uses one phrase for a price record and for a habit.
The hook's other half. Hitting a bong is the vice. "For an all time high" then means both the smoke and the chart. The two lines are the pun, stacked.

Fibonacci ratios are numbers traders draw on charts to guess where a move "should" stop or extend. "How did my bags get heavy? I tell them Fibonacci" treats that drawing as the excuse for a position that got large.
A bag is the position you hold. Heavy bags are a stack big enough to feel. Through the 2021–22 run, "my bag" was how people talked about what they were sitting on.
NFTs are non-fungible tokens, the 2021 collectible boom. "Increase my stacks" was the pitch: the token would make the rest of the bag bigger. A lot of floors went the other way.
A DApp is software that talks to a blockchain instead of a company server. "DAPPs on DAPPs" is the pile from that cycle: a new front end for every trade, farm, and game, most of them not on Bitcoin.
FOMO is fear of missing out: buying because the chart is vertical and the chat is loud. The line is the brake. The chase is how the tuition in this song gets paid.
A blockchain is an append-only ledger. By 2021 the word was also a sticker on NFTs and DApps. The chant uses it as the era's drum hit between those pitches.

The Bitcoin line is "don't trust, verify": check the rules yourself, don't take an exchange's word. The lyric drops the comma. "That's how I can get to sleep" is the claim that verification, not a promise, is what holds.

phrase: The floor price is like lava
note: Floor price is the cheapest listing, the NFT-market word for the bottom of a collection. Sweeping the floor meant buying those cheapest tokens. Lava that "cannot be swept" means the bottom is there and it still burns.

phrase: Come into Vegas roll the dice
note: Vegas is the casino. Tourists come in, roll, and leave. The verse just called the money ex's that multiply — visitors, not residents — and the dice are the trades.
Ex's: former partners, and the letter x, as in multiply. The money shows up, multiplies, and does not stay. The pun is the line.
The refrain. Coins already spent or lost, and the wish to have the stack again. Pizza Day is the calendar for that: bitcoin traded for something ordinary, looked at later against a much higher price.
Tuition is what the market charges for learning it live. The fees are drawdowns, rugs, and bad entries, not a university bill. "I have learnt my lessons" is the line before it.
The past tense is the point. The lesson already cost something. The rest of the verse is what the cost bought: dips, a floor like lava, and a rule about verifying.
A dip is a drop people tell you to buy. Incessant means they keep coming. After an all-time high, the way down is a series of dips that each look like the last chance.
Certainty is a guaranteed outcome. Markets do not issue one. The next line answers with speed instead of a promise.
The reply to people waiting to be sure. Urgency is acting before the picture is clean. The verse then takes the red Ferrari and the red candle as the same motion.
A red Ferrari is the cycle's status car. "Gone swerve" is it leaving the lane. "Give me the red" on the line before sets up the paint, and the chart color, in one word.
A price alert from an app or an exchange. "Look it's red" is the notification firing: the print came in red. The Ferrari and the candle share the color.
Red on a chart means price fell. The alert says red, and the bar says he ain't scared. Same word as the Ferrari, now as a candle.
A vice is a habit you already know is costing you. He names it after the bong and the all-time high: he knew, and he still did it. The bags are what's left.
The question pointed at the FOMO, the dice, and the lava floor. Rationality would be size and time. The chart in this verse is not offering either.
The refrain, before the ask for the coins back. A lesson is what remains after the price and the vice. Stressing is the feeling. The bitcoin is what he wants returned.
